operation.source_intent: For each authoritative global post row, expose navigation to the owning site, that exact post editor, and that site's content explorer.

laravel_adaptation.authoritative_read: Existing GET /api/v1/tenants/{tenant}/global-posts collection; the control performs no secondary request.
laravel_adaptation.explorer_adaptation_reason: Laravel's canonical Explorer route is tenant-scoped and site-bound through the validated site query.
laravel_adaptation.loading_empty_error: Inherited from GlobalPostsConfirmTrashControl's authoritative global-posts query: explicit loading, error and empty states render before row controls.

security_boundary.tenant_endpoint: Global posts are returned only through auth + tenant.context for the active tenant.
security_boundary.tenant_isolation: Site and WordPress identifiers come from tenant-scoped persisted rows; caller-supplied site_id/wordpress_id query parameters are ignored.
security_boundary.identity_input: Only positive integer site_id and wordpress_id values from the authoritative row are accepted; malformed identifiers fail closed.
security_boundary.network_effect: none in the visible control; navigation only

coverage: exact canonical operation identity and all source interpolated href fragments
tenant-bound site, post editor and Explorer destinations
guest, missing-permission, foreign-tenant and foreign-site fail-closed behavior
no fetch, API mutation or synthetic success path in the control
